messages:
anna: quick sync — boreal POC. They want three prioritized journeys, a minimal eval plan, and confirmation of security & pricing constraints before next Tue. Can we outline what we need from them?

devon: quick list from my side: 1) support assistant (retrieval + generation), 2) product recommender (rerank + short explanation), 3) automated compliance redaction (PII detection + redact). Prioritize 1 -> 2 -> 3.

anna: agreed. @sanjay can you confirm which of those are must-have vs nice-to-have for the pilot? Also expected QPS and p95 latency SLOs?

sanjay: must-have = support assistant (1), recommender = nice-to-have but valuable, redaction = required for final contract but can be mocked in pilot. QPS: average 5 rps, burst to 20. p95 latency target ~300ms for single-turn responses (user-facing). Need SSO + VPC + KMS. Data cannot leave customer VPC for embeddings or sensitive context.

hamid: thanks @sanjay. Security checklist notes: 1) SAML SSO/SCIM for accounts, 2) KMS/HSM integration for key wrapping, 3) VPC peering or Private Deployment (air-gapped if required), 4) data retention policy 90 days max, 5) model audit logs preserved. For pilot, we can use Dedicated with strict network rules.

charlie: pricing note — for avg 5 rps with bursts to 20, recommended: Dedicated small pool (1-2 GPUs) + burst on-hosted or reserved burst minutes. Ballpark commit: $6k/mo for dedicated baseline + metered burst. If they must keep embeddings private inside VPC we push Private (higher upfront).

anna: action items from this thread: - confirm endpoints and example prompts - define eval harness (prompt sets + pass/fail) - final security Q answers - provide a sample Dedicated cost calc.

devon: for endpoints I'd propose: POST /v1/predict/support -> retrieval + generate, POST /v1/predict/recommend -> candidate rerank, POST /v1/ops/redact -> PII detector. Each endpoint should include: input schema, context size limit, expected tokens out, and fallback policy.

devon: sample prompt templates (very short):
```
# support
User: "{question}"\nContext: "{top_5_faiss_chunks}"\nAssistant: "Answer succinctly with source citations (format: [doc-id])."
```

```
# recommender
System: "You are a product recommender. Given user profile {profile}, rank these candidates and give one-line rationale."
```

anna: nice. For evals we need ~200 seed prompts for support (mix of factual, opinion, multi-step). Pass criteria: 85% accuracy on factual q's and no hallucinations above tolerance threshold (measured by citation match). For recommender: 70% business metric alignment on a small holdout. Redaction: 100% PII removal on test set.

hamid: on citations/hallucination checks — we'll need ground-truth snippets and a human-in-loop for initial 2 weeks. Add requirement: token-level audit logs and per-response model hash.

sanjay: operational constraints: we can't send raw customer PII to hosted models. If we must, we need explicit data flow diagrams and a signed DPA. Prefer Private deployment but can accept Dedicated if embeddings and context remain in VPC.

anna: @charlie can you produce a brief cost comparison (hosted vs dedicated vs private) with the above QPS and retention? Need by EOD tomorrow.

charlie: on it. I'll include assumptions (tokens per response = 150, embeddings per doc = 1024 dims, storage snapshot freq).

devon: deployment plan suggestion: week 0-1: infra + SSO/KMS setup (dev sandbox), week 2: ingest seed docs + run retrieval tuning, week 3: run eval harness + human review, week 4: go/no-go and canary to 5% traffic.

anna: timeline OK for them? @sanjay pls confirm availability of 2 engineers for week 1-3 and a product SME for evals.

sanjay: we can commit 2 engs for weeks 1-3 and a product SME for week 3. Good to proceed.

hamid: one blocker to note: Boreal's security team needs completed vendor questionnaire (we have answers for most items but they'll ask about model training data provenance and redaction guarantees). @anna please attach our standard security pack and the hosted/dedicated architecture diagrams.

deploy-bot: new artifact created: security-questionnaire-boreal-2034567890 (uploaded by anna).

anna: uploaded the pack and architecture diagram to the thread. Also included the minimal network diagram for Dedicated + VPC peering.

devon: sample API curl for testing (dev sandbox):
```
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/predict/support \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"question":"How do I reset my password?","context": ["doc1","doc2"]}'
```

charlie: couple of negotiation knobs to lower cost: longer commit term (12mo), model quantization (Q4-bit) for non-critical flows, or route non-sensitive traffic to hosted cheaper variants. We'll model each.

anna: next steps (concise): 1) charlie -> cost comparison (EOD tomorrow) 2) devon -> endpoints + eval skeleton (tomorrow AM) 3) hamid -> fill security questionnaire gaps (48hrs) 4) sanjay -> confirm infra access + two engineers (today).

sanjay: confirmed infra access request raised, engineers assigned.

anna: thanks everyone — I'll draft the POC success criteria doc and ping legal for DPA. :thumbsup:

devon: one last ask: can we include a small prompt set exemplars in the security answers so they can see content flows? I'll add 10.

hamid: please redact PII in the exemplars (use placeholders like <EMAIL>, <SSN>).

anna: noted. Closing thread for now, will reopen if any blocker surfaces.
